item_summary: $70-100 acoustic desktop privacy panel with sound-absorbing recycled PET materials and a non-destructive clamp-on mounting system
detailed_item_draft: Acoustic desktop privacy panel specification: Price target $70-$100 USD. Material composition: 100% recycled PET felt or high-density sound-absorbing polyester with verified acoustic dampening capabilities. Dimensions: Minimum 24 inches height x 18 inches width to ensure adequate screen coverage. Mounting: Non-destructive clamp-on mechanism designed for desk edges between 0.5 and 2 inches thick; must not require drilling, screws, or adhesive. Stability: Integrated wide-base clamp or weighted bottom to prevent toppling. Aesthetic: Neutral color palette (gray, black, white, or beige) with smooth or textured felt surface. Durability: Flame-retardant treated where possible, easy to clean surface. Configuration: Single panel unit preferred, adjustable tilt angle optional. Packaging: Eco-conscious labeling indicating recycled content percentage.
